facts.claim: In the spring of 1863, the Wide West brick mill had 20 stamps and 40 pans running.
facts.quote: a brick mill known as the Wide West, 20 stamps, 40 pans, running: the Union mill at the lower end of town, 8 stamps running on custom ore;

facts.claim: The Cooper mill was located down the Aurora canyon and had 4 stamps while being idle.
facts.quote: down the Aurora canyon, the Napa mill, idle; just below that the Cooper mill, 4 stamps, idle; still further down a mill known at that time as the Antelope mill

facts.claim: Freight lumber from Folsom to Aurora cost eighty to one hundred dollars per thousand.
facts.quote: Lumber at $80 to $100 per thousand for freight from Folsom to Aurora. Late in the fall of 1862, Winters paid, to my knowledge, 14 cents a pound
